verdict.rationale: Viam documents fleet-wide management: a fleet management API to create and manage organizations, locations, machines, and fragments, plus OTA software updates and canary testing with rollbacks. Locations suggest a grouping unit and canary testing suggests staged rollouts, but the evidence never explains how fragments propagate shared config to many machines or how a rollout targets a specific group. missing for 10: explicit docs showing one config change pushed to multiple machines at once, documented per-group targeting (by location or tag) for config rollouts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
